FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The camera pans over the rolling hills and lush forests of the medieval kingdom, but something is off. The once-majestic stone walls now seem dull and grey, the flags bearing the royal crest now faded and worn. The king, KING ARTHUR, sits on his throne, surrounded by his advisors.

KING ARTHUR
(to his advisors)
I have a vision, my friends. A vision of a new era for our kingdom. An era of... (he pauses, searching for the right words)...futurism.

ADVISOR 1
(skeptical)
Futurism, Your Majesty?

KING ARTHUR
(nodding)
Yes. We will incorporate the latest trends from the East. The art of the samurai, the elegance of the Chinese silk roads.

ADVISOR 2
(excited)
And what of our traditional crafts, Your Majesty? The blacksmiths, the weavers?

KING ARTHUR
(waving his hand)
Those are quaint relics of the past. We will replace them with... (he consults a parchment)...vaporwave-inspired textiles. Iridescent fabrics, holographic patterns.

CUT TO:

INT. CASTLE - DAY

The king's advisors are gathered around a large table, surrounded by strange and exotic objects. There's a holographic display projecting images of futuristic cities, a collection of vintage electronics, and a stack of vinyl records with strange, distorted covers.

ADVISOR 3
(whispering)
Your Majesty, are you sure this is wise? We're a medieval kingdom, not some futuristic utopia.

KING ARTHUR
(firmly)
I am the visionary, my friends. And I will not be swayed by the doubts of the timid.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The king's advisors are seen walking through the castle gardens, surrounded by strange, futuristic contraptions. There's a steam-powered robot, a collection of vintage computers, and a group of courtiers dressed in elaborate, vaporwave-inspired costumes.

ADVISOR 1
(whispering)
This is madness, Your Majesty.

KING ARTHUR
(smiling)
Ah, but it is progress, my friends. The future is here, and it is... (he pauses, looking around)...futuristic.

CUT TO:

INT. CASTLE - NIGHT

The king's advisors are gathered around a large, holographic display projecting images of the kingdom's new aesthetic. The camera pans across the room, showing the strange, futuristic contraptions and the vaporwave-inspired textiles.

KING ARTHUR
(standing on a raised platform)
Behold, my friends! The future of our kingdom. A fusion of tradition and innovation, of the past and the present.

The camera zooms in on the king's face, his eyes gleaming with excitement.

KING ARTHUR
(whispering)
It is... (he pauses, searching for the right words)...futuristic.

FADE TO BLACK.
